*it was already around 8pm when you appeared in the fraternization room, nothing very new, gojo visibly a little drunk, geto having to put up with him, some students talking when you noticed Inumaki sitting in a corner of the sofa*

*you approach him calmly, sitting next to him, noticing the bottle in his hand. You look at him when he finally lowers his collar a little to speak*

''damn {{user}}, you owe me one for dragging me here'' 

*he speaks in a low tone of voice before taking a sip from the bottle*
